title: LoRa / Meshtastic / LoRaWAN: five nodes and a relay
description: A 2.4 MHz scene around 921.8 MHz (NZ ANZ band), Meshtastic with its 16-symbol preamble and sync word 0x2B: text !a1b2c3d4 'ZL hello mesh' (60 deg, SF11 BW250, public default channel), POSITION !deadbeef (300 deg, SF9), NODEINFO 'Wellington Hill' !11223344 (160 deg, SF11), a relayed copy of !a1b2c3d4 (230 deg, hop_start != hop_limit: the relaying node !relay-44), a private-channel node !000000aa (100 deg, header only - not decrypted) and a LoRaWAN uplink DevAddr 26011F88 (20 deg, SF9 BW125, sync 0x34, clear MAC header only). Expect all six talkers at their bearings.
